annotations.title: Create a free cluster without an account

description: Creates a free-tier cluster (0.5 GB memory, 2 vCPU burst, one node) with no account and no credential, in the region nearest the caller unless one is given. The answer carries a claim_url for the person you are working with and an access_token for polling; when a ready cluster is on hand it also carries the hostname and an api_key, otherwise status is provisioning and next says what to do (poll get_claimable_cluster about every 60 seconds until ready, and tell the user you are waiting). The api_key reads, writes and searches every collection but cannot delete anything or manage keys; it stays valid for 24 hours after the person claims the cluster. The cluster is deleted 72 hours after creation unless a signed-in person opens the claim_url and claims it into their Typesense Cloud account: give them the link; never open it yourself. Limits per address: 2 clusters per hour, 5 per day.

allOf.description: A Typesense Cloud region currently accepting new clusters.

region.description: A Typesense Cloud region. Defaults to the region nearest the caller.
